title: Protecting the environment – ecology
intro: Nature is one of Allah’s countless blessings – Muslims should be the best ecologists.

learn.title: 📖 In the Qur’an
learn.html: Who created the heavens and the earth and sends down rain for you from the sky, with which We grow beautiful gardens – you could not make their trees grow? Is there another god besides Allah? No – but they are people who make others equal to Him. <small>(Qur’an, An-Naml 27:60, meaning)</small>
Allah (SWT) has given us countless blessings, and one of them is the environment around us. Allah tells us: He created you from the earth and settled you on it. (Qur’an, Hud 11:61, meaning)

The sun that gives us warmth and light, trees, mountains and plains – in short, the whole world of plants and animals – are beauties given to us to use. But besides using the environment and living in it, we must also look after it so that it stays beautiful, guided by the words of the Prophet (SAW): “Truly, Allah is beautiful and He loves beauty.” (Muslim)
The beauty of our surroundings shows how much we care about nature. Muslims should be the best ecologists and the most aware of protecting the nature that Allah (SWT) created.
Ecology is the science that studies the relationships between living beings. So we can say that Muslims:

items: use the blessings of nature in moderation and wisely,
treat animals carefully and do not torture them,
use animals that are allowed as food in the prescribed way,
protect natural resources (springs, rivers, forests, streams…) and do not destroy them,
look after green areas, their yards and the grounds of the mosque,
try to renew the land and forests they use as natural resources.

learn.html: The Prophet (SAW) and all his Companions recommended working unused land. The Sahabah understood this and practised it – it is part of Islam. Planting and working the land gives us food, cleans the air and stops the soil from washing away. There is another very important reason too: to make the earth more beautiful.

People need natural resources like wood, but that does not mean we may cut down trees completely and without control. We should try to plant more than we cut, so that nature can renew itself. Whatever we do for nature brings us many kinds of benefit.

learn.title: 📜 Hadith
learn.html: The Prophet (SAW) said: “Whenever a Muslim plants a plant, he will have a reward for everything eaten from that plant, such as by birds or animals. This reward will continue until the Day of Judgement.” (Nasa’i)

learn.title: 📖 Look at your food
learn.html: Allah invites us to think about the beauty of plants and animals: Let people look at their food – how We pour down rain, then split the earth and make grain grow in it, and grapes and vegetables, olives and palm trees, thick gardens, fruit and pasture, for you and your animals to enjoy. <small>(Qur’an, ‘Abasa 80:24–32, meaning)</small>

learn.title: 🌱 Plant it anyway
learn.html: The Prophet (SAW) said: “If the Day of Judgement comes while one of you has a seedling in his hand, and he is able to plant it, let him plant it.” (Bukhari, Al-Adab al-Mufrad)

practice.title: Good for the earth?
practice.prompt: Does a Muslim ecologist do this?

items.text: Planting a tree in the yard
Turning off water you are not using
Planting more trees than you cut
Cutting down a whole forest without control

practice.title: A Muslim and nature
practice.prompt: Tap every sentence that matches what the book teaches, then tap Check.

options.text: We use nature’s blessings in moderation
Planting brings reward as long as birds, animals or people eat from it
Allah is beautiful and loves beauty
Working the land gives food, cleans the air and stops the soil washing away
Nature is ours, so we can waste it however we like
options.why: Nature is a blessing from Allah – we use it wisely and look after it.

options.text: There is no point planting a tree if you won’t live to eat its fruit
options.why: The Prophet (SAW) told us to plant a seedling even if the Day of Judgement were coming.

practice.title: Questions, tasks and talk
prompts: ❓ What is ecology? What does the word mean, and what does ecology cover?
🌍 How do Muslims become the best ecologists?
📝 Task: Write in your maktab notebook and learn some ayahs of the Qur’an and hadiths of the Prophet (SAW) connected to ecology.
